title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI gating + metrics integration (BLEU/ROUGE) and GitHub Action hook
author: Priya Patel
description: Add per-prompt CI gating and evaluation metrics integration to the eval-harness. Motivation: we need deterministic regression detection per prompt set across model rollouts and a lightweight metrics hook that computes BLEU/ROUGE and simple diversity/length stats as part of CI. This PR introduces: 1) a per-prompt gating config format (eval-harness/config/quality_gates.yaml) that allows teams to declare threshold tolerances per prompt set and model family; 2) a metrics integration module (eval-harness/metrics/rouge_bleu.py) with a small, dependency-light implementation used by CI; 3) a GitHub Actions workflow (ci/workflows/eval-harness-per-prompt.yml) that runs evals on PRs touching prompts or model-serving code and fails the job when thresholds are violated; 4) a reusable Action hook and runner shim (eval-harness/ci/hooks/per_prompt_gate.py) used by Dedicated and Private CI pipelines; 5) docs and examples demonstrating how to author gates and interpret results. This PR is intended to be backward compatible with existing eval configs; when no gate is present, CI will only publish metrics but not fail. Please see commits for implementation notes and the review comments for discussion on thresholds and caching behavior.
commits: add per-prompt gating config schema and example
implement rouge/bleu metrics module with unit tests
add GitHub Actions workflow and CI hook shim
docs: gating usage and migration notes

release_notes:

- Backwards compatible: gates are opt-in
